PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Y undo and redo for building, painting, grid paste and delete, terminal changes and text fields.
PluginData.Description:
Undo and redo with Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Y
- Placing and removing blocks, grid splits included - Removed blocks come back with their settings, inventory and toolbar slots - Rotors, hinges, pistons and connectors come back with what they held - Painting and skins - Pasting and deleting grids - Terminal property changes, block and grid names - Custom Data and block toolbars - Programmable block programs - Single line text fields - Grid history (Ctrl-H): put a deleted grid back on the clipboard
The history is saved with the world and follows its backups.
Where it works: - Offline games in creative, or in survival with creative tools enabled - Friends multiplayer if you are the host, with the same game mode rules - Not in multiplayer hosted on a dedicated server, nor when joining a friend's game. A client could only do very little there, and even that would be cheaty.
Where it is off, it records nothing and all keys stay as in the game.
Relative dampeners and toggle all reactors move to Ctrl-Shift-Z and Ctrl-Shift-Y. With nothing to undo, Ctrl-Z is still relative dampeners. All keys can be changed in the plugin settings.
